create_BenchmarkLMDataset: create a BenchmarkLMDataset with custom vocab size, max source positions, and total samples for benchmarking
use_BenchmarkLMDataset_getitem: use BenchmarkLMDataset getitem to retrieve a random source-target token pair by index
use_BenchmarkLMDataset_len: use BenchmarkLMDataset len to get the total number of samples in the dataset
run_collate_sentences_lm: run collate_sentences_lm to batch sample dictionaries into stacked source and target tensors
test_BenchmarkLMDataset: test the BenchmarkLMDataset class by iterating over samples and verifying tensor shapes
